summary: Run the full retained source scan family through corrected operators with explicit state and limits.

identity.relation: Complete bounded effective multi-fluid spectrum scan and terminal projection
identity.direction: species,selectors,grids -> complete scan spectra, last-point matrices/state, plotting
identity.definition: Initialize once; for each source-selected k point assemble the corrected matrix and compute the conditioned eigenspectrum; collect every sorted mode and retain the last-point M,A,w1,w2,state. Methods2/3/4 retain defaults101/196 magnitude points,51 angles,50x75 Cartesian mesh and row-major kz then kx order. Single branch handles0/1 and unknown nonnegative selectors. Then produce a two-panel PNG in Agg for2/3/4; other selectors retain zero axes. Optional SI positional return is (M,A,w1,w2,kk,ww1,ww2,betasz,vA,csz2,c2,rhos0,wcs,qs,ms,wps,B0) prefix, all defined.
identity.model: Composition of fresh state, corrected local multi-fluid matrix and conditioned spectrum; source scan grids retained
identity.geometry: x-z wavevector scans; B0 along z
identity.coordinates: Scan axes precede mode axis; Cartesian shape [kz_index,kx_index,mode]
identity.boundary: Entire scan bounded by max_points; failure aborts without partial scientific results; independent sorting is not branch continuation
assumptions: Effective local algebraic thermal model; not full entropy evolution, CGL, kinetic physics, or the unmagnetized drift-directed Appendix A model.
Background sources and prescribed acceleration per mass have zero perturbation response. Gradients define a local/eikonal symbol, not an inhomogeneous global Maxwell-Gauss boundary solution.
The magnetic longitudinal pressure-divergence factor two is a phenomenological mirror correction; no universal kinetic mirror threshold or experimental accuracy claim.
Relativistic inertia is d(gamma*v)/dv with retained noncovariant pressure and friction; no fully covariant thermodynamics claim.

inputs.name: species
inputs.description: Rows q,m,n,vx,vy,vz,cs_parallel,cs_perpendicular,eps_x,eps_y; one header line for text.
inputs.units: SI C,kg,m^-3,m/s,m^-1 by quantity; normalized units fixed by explicit c2,epsilon0 and B0
inputs.constraints: s>=1, m/n>0, cs>=0; None uses documented example rows; rows are independent fluids, including equal rows. Default normalized rows: [-1,1,4,0,0,0,0,0,0,0], [1,4,4,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]. Default SI rows: [-1.602e-19,9.109e-31,8.7e6,0,0,0,4.631e6,4.631e6,0,0], [1.602e-19,1.673e-27,8.7e6,0,0,0,9.360e4,9.360e4,0,0].

inputs.name: unit
inputs.constraints: normalized or si, without input conversion.

inputs.name: method
inputs.constraints: 0/1 and unknown nonnegative integers single point;2 magnitude,3 angle,4 Cartesian mesh.

inputs.name: rel
inputs.description: Inertia selector passed unchanged to matrix assembly.

inputs.name: vectors
inputs.constraints: Does not change the eigenvalue calculation path.

inputs.name: oldmethod
inputs.constraints: 1 generalized SciPy eig; 2 eig of solve(A,M); both use balanced coordinates and the same refinement checks.

inputs.name: prior
inputs.description: Prior state accepted for call compatibility, never used as primary scientific input.
inputs.constraints: Every field is freshly derived; prior is not mutated.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Constants B0,c2,epsilon0,gammaTs; collision controls and classification.
inputs.units: B0 in T/SI or normalized; c2 speed squared; epsilon0 SI or normalized; rates s^-1 or normalized frequency
inputs.constraints: Only documented fields; c2/epsilon0/gammaTs>0. Explicit rates receiver i toward j, zero diagonal, nonnegative and rho reciprocal. drag_rates>=0. Legacy nue/nui light/heavy bath, nuei light-receiver cross-class, same-class nuee/nuii lower-rho receiver. Default mass classes normalized<=1 or SI<=9.1093837139e-31 kg; collision_classes explicit light/heavy (electron/ion aliases) overrides. These are numerical categories, not inferred species identities. Defaults normalized: B0=1,c2=1,epsilon0=1,gammaTs=1; SI: B0=8e-9 T,c2=(2.9979e8)^2,epsilon0=8.854e-12,gammaTs=5/3. All five legacy rates zero; absent explicit pair/drag rates derive from those zero controls. Default classes use the declared mass threshold.

inputs.name: k_grid
inputs.units: m^-1 SI or normalized inverse length
inputs.constraints: Finite nonempty; method2 only. Default101 normalized or196 SI literal-source samples.

inputs.name: theta_grid
inputs.constraints: Finite nonempty; method3 only. Default51 samples0..pi/2.

inputs.name: kx_grid
inputs.units: m^-1 SI or normalized inverse length
inputs.constraints: Finite nonempty; method4 only. Default75 samples. Shape order [Z,X,N].

inputs.name: kz_grid
inputs.units: m^-1 SI or normalized inverse length
inputs.constraints: Finite nonempty; method4 only. Default50 samples.

inputs.name: k
inputs.units: m^-1 SI or normalized inverse length
inputs.constraints: Finite; applies only single branch. Angle sweep retains source k=2.

inputs.name: theta
inputs.constraints: Finite; method2 source angle pi/4 normalized or0 SI is retained.

inputs.name: max_points
inputs.description: Upper bound on solved scan points.
inputs.constraints: Positive; whole requested scan must fit. No feedback or iteration.

inputs.name: plot_path
inputs.constraints: Only methods2/3/4; Agg generates PNG in memory and writes this path if supplied.

inputs.name: output_count
inputs.constraints: normalized0..4,SI0..17. All branches now define kk,ww1,ww2. None returns mapping.

outputs.name: M
outputs.units: row output units per second divided by column state units; normalized analog

outputs.name: A
outputs.units: dimensionless within equally scaled velocity blocks
outputs.constraints: Identity except d(gamma*v)/dv in rel=1 velocity blocks.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: Revalidated fresh state used by the matrix.
outputs.constraints: No stale derived fields; preserves explicit collision classes.

outputs.name: scales
outputs.description: Positive physical state-column scales for similarity transformation.
outputs.constraints: Density=n_j, velocity=c, B=sqrt(sum(rho)/epsilon0), E=c*B; transforms rows and columns consistently.

outputs.name: kx
outputs.units: m^-1 SI or normalized inverse length

outputs.name: kz
outputs.units: m^-1 SI or normalized inverse length

outputs.name: w1
outputs.description: Frequencies sorted by decreasing real part.
outputs.constraints: omega=i*lambda; stable ties; not mode tracking.

outputs.name: w2
outputs.description: Same modes sorted by decreasing imaginary part.

outputs.name: X1
outputs.units: mixed state units with max-absolute normalization
outputs.constraints: Only the mapping with vectors=True exposes corresponding last-point vectors; public positional prefixes do not contain vectors. Arbitrary phase and degenerate basis.

outputs.name: X2
outputs.units: mixed state units with max-absolute normalization
outputs.constraints: Only the mapping with vectors=True exposes corresponding last-point vectors; public positional prefixes do not contain vectors. Arbitrary phase and degenerate basis.

outputs.name: residual1
outputs.description: Scaled global backward error for w1.
outputs.constraints: Finite and at most1e-10; not a forward-accuracy certificate.

outputs.name: residual2
outputs.description: Scaled global backward error for w2.

outputs.name: component_residual
outputs.constraints: 50-decimal fallback if double exceeds1e-12; reject if final exceeds1e-10.

outputs.name: precision
outputs.constraints: complex128 or mpmath-50-decimal-to-complex128; original input coefficients remain double precision.

outputs.name: kk
outputs.units: m^-1 SI or normalized inverse length
outputs.constraints: Always defined; SI nonscan arities do not return undefined fields.

outputs.name: kkx
outputs.units: m^-1 SI or normalized inverse length

outputs.name: kkz
outputs.units: m^-1 SI or normalized inverse length

outputs.name: ww1
outputs.description: Real-part independently sorted frequencies at every point.
outputs.constraints: Full scan arrays; not continuous mode tracking.

outputs.name: ww2
outputs.description: Imaginary-part independently sorted frequencies at every point.

outputs.name: graphics
outputs.constraints: Two axes for2/3/4, zero axes for other selectors; no one-species mass title indexing or zero color index.

outputs.name: plot_png
outputs.constraints: Methods2/3/4 only; requested file mirrors these bytes.

preconditions: Finite ten-column species data with positive mass/density and nonnegative sound speeds; all configured constants and rates satisfy their declared domains.
Caller chooses consistent SI or normalized quantities; unit selection labels data and selects defaults, and does not implicitly convert arrays.
supported: The complete retained normalized/SI local multi-fluid mapping, source scan selectors and caller-owned state under the explicitly declared effective closure.
excluded: Effective local algebraic thermal model; not full entropy evolution, CGL, kinetic physics, or the unmagnetized drift-directed Appendix A model.
Background sources and prescribed acceleration per mass have zero perturbation response. Gradients define a local/eikonal symbol, not an inhomogeneous global Maxwell-Gauss boundary solution.
The magnetic longitudinal pressure-divergence factor two is a phenomenological mirror correction; no universal kinetic mirror threshold or experimental accuracy claim.
Relativistic inertia is d(gamma*v)/dv with retained noncovariant pressure and friction; no fully covariant thermodynamics claim.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid units, shape, nonfinite data, physical signs, rates, selectors, or a numerically unrepresentable state. The matrix rejects rel=1 at or above c.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Native NumPy/SciPy/mpmath or file export failures propagate; ArithmeticError rejects residual or eigenvector failure.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No physical iteration. Numerical eigensolver failure propagates; no result is claimed on failure.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No result dictionary is returned after failure; an explicitly requested PNG is a caller-directed file side effect.

from scirel.kinetic import evaluate_pdrf_dispersion
r = evaluate_pdrf_dispersion(method=2, k_grid=[0, .1])

execution.ordering: initialize; finite row-major point schedule; assemble then spectrum per point; collect terminal then plot. One pass, at most max_points(default10000); no state feedback.
branches: vectors and oldmethod forwarded unchanged; positive point bound checked before loop
execution.state_ownership: Caller inputs remain untouched; fresh graph-local state; prior contributes no fields. Each point derives from the same explicit primaries.
execution.failure_propagation: First invalid input, arithmetic, eigensolver or export failure propagates; no partial result dictionary.
